sections.Aim and Purpose: Learn from real-world case studies how regulators use AI to strengthen oversight and efficiency.
sections.Intended Audience: Mid-level supervisory staff building capability in AI-related supervision and internal AI use.
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some familiarity with artificial intelligence is helpful but not essential.

related.title: Agentic Finance for Supervisors
related.summary: A ten-module programme equipping supervisors to understand and supervise AI agents that transact and make financial decisions, from agent identity to payments and liability.

related.title: AI Governance for Supervisors
related.summary: A ten-module programme equipping supervisors to assess firms' AI governance, model and fairness risk, and to shape the authority's approach to AI supervision.

related.title: The EU AI Act and Financial Services (EU Edition)
related.summary: An eight-module programme on the EU AI Act for supervisors and financial firms: risk classification, high-risk credit and insurance uses, provider and deployer duties, supervision and compliance programmes.
